title: car-pi findings rule file
description: Checks evaluated against a completed scan. Rules are data so contributors can add checks without touching Python.

title.description: One-line finding headline shown in the report.

severity.description: 'critical' means walk away. 'high' means investigate or budget before buying. 'medium'/'low' are advisory. 'info' is context, not a defect.

when.description: Boolean expression over scan facts. If any fact it references is absent, the rule is skipped as inapplicable rather than evaluated as false -- a missing PID must never read as a clean bill of health.

requires.description: Extra facts that must be present for applicability, for rules that reference a fact only inside one branch of the expression.

explain.description: Plain-language explanation for a non-specialist buyer, including what to do next.
